mapper.select: SELECT investigation_id, incident_id, aggregate_version, status, current_run_id, steps_used, tool_calls_used, no_progress_rounds, snapshot_json, snapshot_sha256, created_at, updated_at FROM authority_investigation_head WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId}

SELECT investigation_id, aggregate_version, status, snapshot_json, snapshot_sha256, recorded_at FROM authority_investigation_revision WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId} ORDER BY aggregate_version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authority_tool_use ( tool_use_id, investigation_id, run_id, tool_name, contract_version, argument_sha256, argument_names_json, argument_size_bytes, target_scope, correlation_id, status, reason_code, evidence_references_json, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{toolUseId}, #{investigationId}, #{runId}, #{toolName}, #{contractVersion}, #{argumentSha256}, #{argumentNamesJson}, #{argumentSizeBytes}, #{targetScope}, #{correlationId}, #{status}, #{reasonCode}, #{evidenceReferencesJson}, #{occurredAt} )
